audit_scope: Read-only tool trajectory and budget-hook audit of development completion-v2 q001 single pair; no answer grading, blind judge access, model rerun or git change.

definitions.call: First occurrence of a unique tool_use id, ordered by stream emission.
definitions.tool_round: Unique assistant message.id containing at least one tool_use; multiple tools in that message count as one round. This differs from result.num_turns and is not assumed to equal SDK billing/limit units.
definitions.evidence_arrival: Exact complete frozen-source lines returned by a tool, unioned across returns; a retrieved location or partial preview is not counted as full evidence, and source arrival is not solver understanding or answer correctness.
definitions.characters: Unicode code points, not tokens or billed cost.

tool_return_volume.definition: Sum Unicode code points / UTF-8 bytes of user message tool_result content text only; excludes duplicate root tool_use_result payload, JSON framing, assistant text, hidden thinking and usage tokens.

read_overlap.definition: Exact frozen-source (path,line) pairs in Read results; repeat means same source line returned by a subsequent Read, not repeated reasoning or intention.

all_tools_source_overlap.note: Includes Grep-to-Read and search-preview-to-Read overlap, often useful navigation or contextual follow-up; not automatically waste.

comparison.repetition_conclusion: Only a small reduction in exact line-level rereading is present. Both arms used 10 Reads and no exact duplicate tool requests. The major observed text-volume difference is narrower Read scope versus baseline full-file reads; it is not supported to describe the whole difference as eliminating repeated reading.
comparison.mechanism_observation: The zg query located recover() at rank 1 in round 1 and was followed by targeted native reads. Complete frozen C1-C3 source evidence arrived at baseline call 16 / round 12 versus zg call 17 / round 9. The zg arm therefore did not require fewer tool calls to collect that fixed full bundle, though it reached it in fewer tool-bearing message rounds and earlier elapsed time.
comparison.stats_coverage_caution: Baseline returned complete E11 CollectionImpl::Stats and E12 doc_count source. The zg trajectory returned E12 but not E11; this is a coverage observation only, not a quality score.
comparison.budget_conclusion: Both arms crossed the 18-call warning branch and ended normally below 24 calls and 600 seconds. No denial was observed. Stream capture does not expose hook additionalContext delivery; warning decisions are reconstructed from identical pinned hook code and state.
comparison.claim_strength: Descriptive single development pair only; no causal attribution, stability/generalization claim, or independently established savings due to zg.

limitations: One sequential baseline-then-zg pair, no replication or order randomization; runtime/model variability may contribute.
24-call threshold was chosen after V1 trajectory inspection; this remains development evidence, not a confirmatory holdout.
V1 and completion-v2 differ in shared instructions/hook protocol, so before/after completion cannot isolate zg or the hook as the cause.
Complete source-span bundles are conservative audit definitions; partial or alternative evidence can support correct answers. Missing a span is not itself an answer error.
Tool text volume omits context scaffolding, model reasoning and cached-prefix effects; it is not token billing or verified dollar cost.

No benchmark source code, model, reproduction or blind evaluator was executed for this audit. Final answer files were hashed as opaque bytes; content quality and hidden thinking contents were not analyzed.
